name: Naphyrone
summary: A drug derived from pyrovalerone which acts as a TRI, producing stimulating effects. The drug has been sold in a blend called "NRG-1". There is limited information on the drug's safety profile.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: As a triple reuptake inhibitor, naphyrone has been shown in vitro to affect the reuptake of the neurotransmitters serotonin, dopamine and norepinephrine by interacting with the serotonin transporter (SERT), dopamine transporter (DAT), and norepinephrine transporter (NET).

uses.text: Naphyrone has been reported as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: There is limited information on its safety. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, agitation, paranoia, sleeplessness and a strong urge to keep redosing, and in serious cases seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的安全性資料有限。它所屬的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高、激動、妄想、失眠以及強烈想要追加使用的衝動，嚴重時會出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的安全性数据有限。它所属的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高、激动、妄想、失眠以及强烈想要追加使用的冲动，严重时会出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: Naphyrone was first described in the 1980s in work on pyrovalerone, then reappeared decades later sold under the name NRG-1 after the United Kingdom banned mephedrone.
fact.zh: 萘吡酮最早在 1980 年代研究吡咯戊酮時被描述，數十年後在英國禁止甲氧麻黃酮後，又以「NRG-1」的名義重新出現。
fact.zhHans: 萘吡酮最早在 1980 年代研究吡咯戊酮时被描述，数十年后在英国禁止甲氧麻黄酮后，又以「NRG-1」的名义重新出现。
